CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.

   B. Refusing to help a neighbour

   B. Waste food daily
